name: An Ordinary Egg
summary: Curgle Cranklehop works with ordinary hippogryph eggs, which are a coin toss: about half of them hatch. Curgle tends them and hopes for luck.

sections.title: Half a Chance
sections.body: An ordinary hippogryph egg hatches only about half the time. Curgle Cranklehop does their best to nurture each one, and with some luck it will hatch.

faq.answer: Curgle Cranklehop is the inventor of the Super Egg-O-Matic, and works with the hippogryph eggs found in Feralas.

faq.q: What happens to the ordinary hippogryph egg?
aliases: what does curgle do with the egg
faq.answer: Curgle tends it and hopes for luck, since only about half of such eggs hatch.

faq.q: Where do these eggs come from?
aliases: where do i find the egg
